item.text: {"findings":[{"severity":"major","cites":["A-0003","C-0013","C-0021"],"kind":"gap","klass":"actionable","argument":"`A-0003` says to replace each non-alphanumeric character with a space, but it never defines whether \"alphanumeric\" is ASCII-only or Unicode-aware. In Python, `str.isalnum()` treats many non-ASCII letters as alphanumeric, which would preserve them and violate `C-0013`'s output charset while also conflicting with `C-0021`'s requirement that non-ASCII input not be transliterated.
